The ''' ''Rainhawk''-class transport''',<ref name="TVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> also known as the '''Pantoran cruiser''',<ref name="Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sphere-of-influence-concept-art-gallery|text="Sphere of Influence" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 8}}</ref> was a model of [[transport]]. [[Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida]], the [[Supreme Chairman]] of the [[Pantoran Assembly]] was known for [[Falfa|owning one]].<ref name="Sphere of Influence" /> The starship seated two in the cockpit, and possessed bunks amidships for long journeys. Favoring defense over offense, the Rainhawk was equipped with powerful [[ion engine]]s and [[repulsorlift]] technology, allowing it to outmaneuver standard [[starfighter]]s, yet not outpace them. The vessel was discontinued before the beginning of the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Starfighters" /> Into the [[Imperial Era]], the [[Twi'lek]] freedom fighter [[Gobi Glie]]'s [[Gobi Glie's starship|personal starship]] was a ''Rainhawk''-class.<ref name="Devil's Deal" />
